prohibited: Counterfeit goods, unauthorized replicas, and goods infringing trademarks, copyrights, patents, or other intellectual-property rights
Weapons, firearms, ammunition, and related components
Explosives, flammable materials, and hazardous chemicals not properly classified
Narcotics, controlled substances, and illegal drugs
Items subject to applicable sanctions, trade embargoes, or export-control requirements without required authorization
Products requiring an export license that has not been obtained
Goods involving sanctioned persons, prohibited counterparties, or prohibited jurisdictions
Human remains, organs, or biological specimens
Live animals (unless covered by specific permits and carrier approvals)
Child exploitation material of any kind
Stolen goods or goods obtained through fraud
Items prohibited by the destination country's import laws
Goods on the US Commerce Control List requiring an export license
restricted: Alcohol and tobacco/nicotine products — subject to destination regulations, applicable licensing, and payment-provider requirements. These categories will not be processed through Stripe unless the activity is permitted under applicable law and Stripe has provided any required prior approval.

Regulated or prescription pharmaceuticals — subject to applicable licensing, destination regulations, and payment-provider requirements. These categories will not be processed through Stripe unless the activity is permitted under applicable law and Stripe has provided any required prior approval.

Regulated medical devices — subject to applicable regulatory clearance, destination requirements, and payment-provider requirements. These categories will not be processed through Stripe unless the activity is permitted under applicable law and Stripe has provided any required prior approval.

High-value goods over applicable thresholds — require additional documentation and are subject to payment-provider requirements. These categories will not be processed through Stripe unless the activity is permitted under applicable law and Stripe has provided any required prior approval.

Precious metals or precious stones — subject to applicable documentation, carrier requirements, and payment-provider requirements. These categories will not be processed through Stripe unless the activity is permitted under applicable law and Stripe has provided any required prior approval.

Currency or negotiable instruments — subject to applicable financial regulations and payment-provider requirements. These categories will not be processed through Stripe unless the activity is permitted under applicable law and Stripe has provided any required prior approval.
Food and perishable items — subject to import health regulations and carrier restrictions.
Electronics with lithium batteries — subject to carrier restrictions and applicable hazardous-materials regulations.
Items requiring CITES permits — subject to applicable wildlife-protection laws and permits.
Goods requiring special import licenses in the destination country — subject to applicable licensing and documentation requirements.
restrictedIntro: Certain regulated or higher-risk categories are not automatically accepted. Acceptance depends on applicable law, destination requirements, carrier requirements, licensing, documentation, and applicable payment-provider approval. A request may be declined even if the underlying product is legal.
